thought.text: Now let me verify page rendering, MongoDB data layer, and the baked build args.

reasoning_content:
All four services up. Health OK. Domain routing works. Admin 200. API users 403 (auth enforced).

Let me verify deeper: the portal page content, the app page, whether Payload↔Mongo actually works (403 shows it reached the auth layer). Let me check the /de portal page renders real content, and Mongo collection presence. Also check the full page actually loads later (the 307 redirect to /de then fetch /de).

Let me also check that NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVER_URL is baked correctly — note guide says set it. The .env has http://localhost:3000 but the web is on 3020. Hmm. Guide says `NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVER_URL`. But access is via 3020. This is a potential mismatch but not necessarily failure — the guide's default port mapping says 3020 host. Actually the guide says NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVER_URL should be set. The summary says retained from example as http://localhost:3000. That's the internal container port, which could matter for client-side fetches. But redirects returned http://localhost:3020 so middleware uses request host. Let me check what's baked.

Let me fetch the actual /de page and /dashboard, check status. And check mongo collections. Also test the media volume mount and backups scripts existence.

Let me also verify the build-time arg baked value in client bundle.

tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && echo \"=== /de portal ===\" && curl -sS -m 30 -o /tmp/de.html -w \"HTTP %{http_code} size=%{size_download}\\n\" -H \"Host: urbankit.de\" http://localhost:3020/de && grep -o -i -m3 '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/de.html; echo \"=== /dashboard app ===\" && curl -sS -m 30 -o /tmp/dash.html -w \"HTTP %{http_code} size=%{size_download}\\n\" -H \"Host: app.urbankit.de\" http://localhost:3020/dashboard && grep -o -i -m3 '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/dash.html; echo \"=== /login ===\" && curl -sS -m 30 -o /dev/null -w \"HTTP %{http_code}\\n\" -H \"Host: app.urbankit.de\" http://localhost:3020/login; echo \"=== baked WS url in bundle ===\" && grep -rlo \"ws://localhost:1234\" /workspace/src 2>/dev/null | head; curl -sS -m 20 -H \"Host: app.urbankit.de\" http://localhost:3020/dashboard | grep -o \"localhost:1234\" | head -1", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Fetch portal, dashboard, login pages"}
